messages:
Anya: Quick design check — proposing a compact 'slab' control for the mini-playground stream. single-row controls: tokens, stop/regenerate, prompt mini-preview. keep streaming text tall and uninterrupted.
Sam: Do you mean the small inline bar under the message vs floating toolbar? I like inline for scannability.
Anya: Inline, yes. Always visible but collapsed on hover for mobile. idea: token counter left, action buttons center, prompt preview right.
Morgan: accessibility nits: make streaming output in an `aria-live="polite"` region so screenreaders get incremental text, and announce when generation finishes or is interrupted. also keyboard focus order needs to be predictable.
Leo: Token counter placement: prefer small pill to the left of actions. show both absolute and delta like `421 (+34)` so users can see new tokens per turn. color: neutral/gray + subtle green when under budget.
Jamie: Microcopy: instead of "Stop" consider "Interrupt" or "Pause"? users may think Stop deletes the partial reply. "Pause" suggests you can resume which we don't support. maybe "Stop" + tooltip "halts generation; partial response saved".
Anya: Good call. Our lab test (n=50) showed 68% confusion when we used "Pause". keep label "Stop" and add tooltip.
Sam: Regenerate label — "Try again" felt more friendly in tests. also consider two-step: small dropdown on regenerate to pick max tokens / temperature quick slider.
Morgan: For screenreader announcements on regen: announce "Regenerating reply" and then clear previous content from the live region before streaming new content to avoid duplicate reads.
Leo: UX question: if user hits Stop then Regenerate quickly, should we keep KV cache to make regen faster or force fresh model run? ops-wise we can do warm-path reuse. pref: reuse to keep latency low and consistent.
Anya: Agree reuse. Also want graceful fallback: if capacity constrained use compact spinner + message "Using faster model to finish this reply" (copy tweak suggestions welcome).
Jamie: Copy suggestion for fallback: "Finishing with a faster model for a quicker response." short + clear.
Sam: Small CSS/HTML nit — ensure hit targets for stop/regenerate are 44px min on touch. current slab button was 32px, causes mis-taps.
Anya: Filed a tiny PR for that. snippet: ```css .mini-slab button{min-height:44px;min-width:44px;padding:6px;} ```
Morgan: Also add ARIA labels for the token pill: `aria-label="tokens used: 421, 34 tokens this turn"`. and ensure color isn't the only channel for status.
Leo: Does console show per-route token budget? We should surface remaining quota in hover for dedicated users.
Jamie: Prompt library inline preview: suggestion to show a tiny icon in slab that opens a flyout with prompt metadata (author, usage count). small preview avoids context switch.
Anya: Love the flyout idea. Keep it read-only in the mini slab. clicking full prompt opens the prompt library.
Sam: One more: animations — streaming fade-in should be fast (120ms) and not shift layout. avoid reflows when token badge updates.
build-bot: deploy-preview available at https://canary.redwood/playground/mini-slab — link expires in 48h. tests: e2e slab interactions passed 14/15, failing keyboard focus test noted.
Anya: Thanks — I'll take the keyboard focus test. assigning to @Morgan to review ARIA fixes. :thumbsup: 
Morgan: On it. I'll drop a small checklist in the PR and attach VoiceOver test notes.
Anya: Great, let's iterate on copy and mobile hit targets first, then accessibility pass.
Sam: +1
Jamie: +1 :sparkles:
Leo: leaving a quick QA note: measure regen latency with reuse vs fresh for 100 samples and share numbers in the PR.
Anya: Cool — we'll collect numbers and reconvene tomorrow.
